name: How long does a kitchen renovation usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a kitchen renovation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a kitchen renovation depends on its complexity and scope. A smaller, cosmetic refresh might be completed in 3-5 weeks. A mid-sized renovation, involving new cabinets and countertops but limited layout changes, typically takes 6-10 weeks. Extensive remodels that include reconfiguring walls, moving plumbing/electrical lines, and custom elements can extend to 10-16 weeks or more. We establish a clear timeline upfront and work to minimize disruption.
acceptedAnswer.description: Renovation timelines vary: 3-5 weeks for a refresh, 6-10 weeks for mid-sized remodels, and 10-16+ weeks for extensive projects.
